permit.title: Permissions on this Mac
permit.lan.ok: Your phone and other computers can connect straight to this Mac.
permit.lan.todo: Not allowed yet. Until then everything goes through the relay: slower, with a data limit.
permit.lan.coach: Look at the screen of “{name}”: macOS is asking whether SoloDawn may find devices on your local network. Click Allow.
permit.lan.settings: Privacy & Security is open on “{name}”. Scroll down to Local Network and switch SoloDawn on.
permit.in.ok: Other devices can reach SoloDawn on this Mac.
permit.in.todo: The Mac's firewall blocks SoloDawn, so other devices only reach it through the relay.
permit.in.settings: Network › Firewall is open on “{name}”. Click Options…, find solodawn and choose “Allow incoming connections”.
permit.files.ask: macOS asks once, the first time an AI uses a folder in Desktop, Documents, Downloads or on an external disk. Click Allow when it does.
permit.files.hint: Worth doing if your AIs work while you are away from this Mac: a question nobody answers stops them.
permit.files.full: Full Disk Access is on. Your AIs can use any folder, and macOS will not ask again.
permit.files.coach: Look at the screen of “{name}”: a small panel sits under System Settings. Drag SoloDawn from the panel into the list above it. If SoloDawn is already in the list, switch it on instead. macOS then asks for Touch ID or your password.
permit.files.plus: Can't drop it? Click + under the list and choose SoloDawn in your Applications folder.
permit.foot.login: macOS also showed “Background Items Added”. That is SoloDawn starting when you log in; nothing to do.
permit.foot.update: After you update SoloDawn, macOS asks these again.
permit.folder.wait: Look at the screen of “{name}”: macOS is asking whether SoloDawn may use this folder. Click Allow.
permit.folder.no: macOS has not allowed SoloDawn to use this folder.
permit.folder.settings: Files and Folders is open on “{name}”. Under SoloDawn, switch on the place this folder is in, then press Try again.
permit.sys.title: Your computer will ask a few things
permit.sys.lead: They appear on the computer's own screen while the AI installs the node.
permit.sys.mac.1: “SoloDawn would like to find devices on your local network”: click Allow.
permit.sys.mac.2: If the firewall is on, “Do you want the application “solodawn” to accept incoming network connections?”: click Allow.
permit.sys.mac.3: A notice “Background Items Added”: nothing to do.
permit.sys.win.1: A “Windows Security” window about the firewall: tick Private networks, then click Allow access. If it asks for an administrator password you do not have, click Cancel: SoloDawn then uses the relay.
permit.win.relay: If Windows asked about SoloDawn and you clicked Cancel, tick SoloDawn under Windows Security › Firewall & network protection › Allow an app through firewall.
